content: Yesure kouŋ jiŋorunji taine peya.

Sabat kombaŋ ŋebi tariko Maria Magdala ŋigo iŋoji Sonda kae fufurere akoŋ wegi jiriŋ sineko jiŋoruŋgo raya. Raru jiŋoine pime rako ko soguine ŋoneko oiji kouŋ gugufuine ore siroŋgone igogabi wareru peya.
Oŋu ŋoneru oo akoŋ bokeru pipa raru Saimon Pita eru Yesure wombuŋ kiŋariŋ yokoreo wareru iŋi yasiya, “Ofonde qoŋgbuŋ jiŋoruŋgone roru raru uro ruabi pega, oi so manegobeneŋ.”
Oŋu yasime bokeru jiŋoruŋgo rabu.
Moko giniŋgaru rabuyoŋ, kiŋariŋ ogoineji giniŋgaru raru Pita odureru rone jiŋoruŋgo ropeya.
Roperu ko kouŋ gugufuine ore maŋineo so roperu siroŋgo omaine tiŋtiŋneku pime rako kambaŋine peperiŋgabuŋ, oi akoŋ peko ŋoneya.
Oi ŋoneme Saimon Pitaji oŋuakoŋ ŋadiineo waperu ko kouŋ maŋineo roperu kambaŋine peperiŋgabuŋ, oi akoŋ peko ŋoneya.
Oi ŋoneko eru qoruine kambaŋ mobeine moji peperiŋgaru komoŋ gabuŋ, oi goineji qajiru sakire kambaŋ oke so qodureru buine ruabi ŋeko ŋoneya.
Oŋu ŋoneme kiŋariŋ ogoineji rone jiŋoruŋgo wapeya, iŋoji oŋuakoŋ ko kouŋ maŋineo roperu ya oi ŋoneru manesiŋ gaya.
Yesu gboreru komegone pakereiŋ, yokoji Biŋe Qurande buŋo oŋuine oi rone so mane taniŋgaru koŋkoŋ go wapebu. Oŋu.
Yesuji Magdala ŋigo Mariareo fukeya.
Ŋe waperu oo akoŋ manesiŋ garu kirieru piyakuŋgo rabu.
Yokoji rabuyoŋ, Mariaji iŋoyoŋe akoŋ jiŋoruŋde ko kouŋ siroŋgo dimaku kuyoya. Oŋu kuyoku kouŋ gugufuine ore maŋineo tiŋtiŋneku pime raya.
Pime rako Sombuŋ mimerereŋ yoyoka marikuyakuŋ gbagbataeŋine ŋone yapeya. Yokoji Yesure qoŋgbuŋ peya, oo ŋebu. Moji qoruine peya, oo ŋeko moji kufuineo ŋeya.
Oŋu ŋeku iŋi ojibu, “Ŋigo, go wamore kuyoge?” Ojibire maneru miya, “Ofoŋnere qoŋgbuŋ roru raru uro ruabi pega, oi so manego.”
Oŋu miku kirieru Yesuji bembeŋgo dimako ŋoneyayoŋ, kamasiine oi so ŋone mukuru koŋkoŋ qaru dimaya.

Koŋkoŋ qaru dimako Yesuji iŋi weu teya, “Ŋigo, go wamore kuyoge? More baage?” Oŋu weu teme kaesesu siŋaŋineji dimaga me uruŋu, oŋuine manesuku iŋi ojiya, “O sogunene, go qoŋgbuŋine roru koboru mogo raru ruage ine, bio najinde raru robemiŋ.”
Oŋu ojime Yesuji tinaine oŋgaku “Maria!” miya. Oi oŋgaku miko iŋoreo kirieru Hibru buŋoo oŋgaku “Raboni!” miya. Oi noŋunde buŋoo “Qaqajine!”
Oŋu miko iŋi ojiya, “Noŋ Mamanereo so roperu yo dimago. Ore eru noŋ so keuwa nuyoŋ, nonde gbopu yoŋoreo raru biŋe iŋi yajiigoŋ: Nonji Mamane Anutu eru ŋoŋore Mama Anutureo kirieru ropebemiŋ.”
Oŋu ojime Magdalane ŋigo Maria iŋoji kirieru raru kiŋariŋpuine iŋi yajiya, “Nonji Ofoŋ ŋonebe buŋo oŋu oŋu najiga.” Oŋu.
Yesuji kiŋariŋpuine fuke yareko.
Sonda oo akoŋ ubu eko kiŋariŋ yoŋo joŋiŋgo tumaŋgaru Juda yoŋore kokoi maneru pi mendiine keku ki baku ŋebuŋ. Oŋu ŋebi Yesuji fukeru botuyaŋuŋgo dimaku iŋi yajiya, “Ogopune, womo ŋoŋoke peine!”
Oŋu miku meyokaine eru tambaraŋine yaduko ŋoneru jeriji maŋyaŋuŋ puseya.
Puseko moke iŋi yajiya, “Ogopune, womo ŋoŋoke peine! Mamaji noŋ sore nume oŋuakoŋ nonji ŋoŋo sore ŋabego.”
Oŋu miku bibi robuŋine pineku miya, “Ŋoŋo Moro Tiriine roniŋ.
Ŋoŋo ŋiŋigo agiburaŋyaŋuŋ bokenimiŋ ine, oi Anuture jiŋoo posike foreiŋ. Ŋiŋigo agiburaŋyaŋuŋ so bokenimiŋ ine, oi Anuture jiŋoo so posikenimiŋ.” Oŋu.
Yesuji Tomas fuke teya.
Yesuji kiŋariŋpuine oŋu fuke yareyayoŋ, kiŋariŋ 12 yoŋoreone mo tinaine Tomas, tinaine mo Didimus mibuŋ, iŋoji damaŋ oo botuyaŋuŋgo so goya.

Tomasji wareko kiŋariŋ goineji “Niŋo Ofoŋ ŋonegobeneŋ,” mibi maneru iŋi miya, “Jiŋoneji biriŋ ropuine meineo ŋoneru me sisineji tambaraŋineo bouabemiŋ ine, oi soine manesiŋ gabemiŋ. Noŋ nake oi so bouabemiŋ ine, buŋo akoŋ najibi oi so manesiŋ gabemiŋ.”

Oŋu miko sonda moakoŋ tariko kiŋariŋ yoŋoji Sonda oo moke pigo qodureru mendi keku ki baku Tomaske moko ŋebuŋ. Moko ŋekabi Yesuji moke fukeru botuyaŋuŋgo dimaku iŋi miya, “Ogopune, womo ŋoŋoke peine!”
Oŋu miku Tomas ojiya, “Go mego bofeŋgaru meyokane roru ŋoneru me sisigoji tambaraŋneo boua. Oŋu eru keta bokeru maŋyoyokago bokeru noŋ manesiŋ nuigoŋ.”
Oŋu ojime iŋi bokirieya, “O, go nonde Ofoŋ Anutune!”
Oŋu bokirieme iŋi ojiya, “Go ŋone nuge ore noŋ soine manesiŋ nugeyoŋ, ŋiŋigo so ŋone nuru jibu noŋ manesiŋ nuegobi, yoŋoji kiwaqawaineke fukegobi.” Oŋu.
Jonji Bobiaŋ Biŋe yo iŋi ore quraŋgaya:
Yesuji gio usuŋ suŋsuŋineke baku gome mosi qoqowirie boakoŋ goine oi kiŋariŋ yoŋore jiŋo paio fukeyayoŋ, oi buk yoo so quraŋgaboŋ.

Buŋo goine quraŋgabe, oi iŋi ore quraŋgaboŋ: Yesuji Anuture Made fukeru Munaŋqoqo Rauine Kristo fukega, ŋoŋo buŋo oi manesiŋ garu oŋuine oo Yesure tinabiŋere eru gogo sanaŋine rauganimiŋ. Oŋu eru gonimiŋ ore nonji Bobiaŋ Biŋe quraŋ yo quraŋgabe ŋoŋoreo warega. Oŋu.
